_doc: Size + comment ratchet. New files must stay under maxNewFileLines. Listed files must not grow. Comment share per directory must not rise. Lower these numbers as the refactor lands; never raise one without a note in 'exceptions'.

exceptions.desktop/tests: 10 -> 11 with no prose added to any existing file: splitting a suite into section TUs adds a file banner per TU while the assertions merely move, so a 60-line extraction carries ~3 comment lines against ~9 of its own — far above the directory's average, which pulls the share up. The MainWindow GUI e2e is one QtTest binary per feature area (MainWindow.<area>.gui.cpp) and a binary runs one QObject of slots, so an area is split only by splitting the binary. Drive this back down as the remaining oversized suites split and their cases merge.

_notes.desktop/tests/MainWindow.chatTurnsViewpo: 257 and structurally capped: chatRowMenuStaysInsideTheViewport is ONE case whose three checker lambdas (checkSurface / checkNarrow / checkSliver, ~160 lines) are called against four chat surfaces, so no group of calls can leave them behind. They close over win.chatDock_ and win.chatMenuPanel_, which are private, so they cannot move to a shared test header either — MainWindow befriends the MainWindowGuiTest class alone. Listed in `files`, NOT in `exceptions`, so the ratchet still refuses growth.
_notes.desktop/src/app/MainWindow.hpp: moc runs on this header, so a MainWindow member has nowhere else to be declared: the dialogs, the core seam and the runners already live outside it. Shrinking it means folding members into owned value-type bags (pop_, fs_, units_, nameBar_, session_ are the precedent), which renames every test call site that reaches them through friend class ::MainWindowGuiTest. Measured: 287 field declaration lines, 136 of them reached by name from desktop/tests and usecases/capture-runner through friend class ::MainWindowGuiTest, and ~500 method declarations moc needs in the class. Bagging every one of the 151 test-free fields would reach ~770, so this file cannot meet the 230 cap while MainWindow is one Q_OBJECT; it is listed in `files`, NOT in `exceptions`, so the ratchet still refuses growth.
_notes.desktop/src/canvas/CanvasWidget.hpp: 432 and moc-bound, like MainWindow.hpp: 119 method declarations form the canvas's public surface and 55 field lines sit behind it, so the ~200 lines this would have to shed cannot come from value-type bags (they would save about 24). Shrinking it means giving the widget a narrower public API, which is a design change rather than a move. Listed in `files`, so it cannot grow.
